instructions: HârnMaster (3rd Edition, Columbia Games) character sheet. Tabs for Character, Inventory, and Settings; auto-calculates encumbrance, penalties (Universal/Physical), endurance, armour-by-location, and mounted-combat stats. Roll buttons cover skill checks and development rolls, weapon attack/defense (including an HM-penalty attack), weapon-break, shock/fumble/stumble, and healing. House-rule toggles and an optional Horse section are on the Settings tab. **Open Settings → Help in the sheet for usage notes, and Settings → Changelog for version history.** Full documentation: [HarnMaster3 README](https://github.com/Roll20/roll20-character-sheets/tree/master/HarnMaster3#readme).
